quote.text: The rule by Nobody is not no-rule, and where all are equally powerless we have a tyranny without a tyrant.
quote.author: Hannah Arendt, On Violence, 1970

stories.headline: Ian Mankin weaves cotton at £39 a metre; Fermoie prints cloth at £180
stories.dek: Both sell into the same London workrooms, where making up an interlined pair ran £284 to £762 in 2023 — and the workroom, not the cloth, decides the result.

stories.kicker: The Kit · The Flicker In Apple’s Best Screen
stories.headline: Apple’s new MacBook Pro screen flickers at 240 hertz, and owners report headaches
stories.dek: Notebookcheck measured a 56 per cent amplitude at 99 per cent brightness and below, then scored Apple’s display 92 per cent and called it the best laptop screen on sale.

stories.headline: Bangladesh pays 13,968 July warriors a pension the Liberation War ministry administers
stories.dek: A ministry letter dated 10 November counts 990 people in the top injury class, against the 493 that Act No. 87 of 2026 still certifies.

stories.headline: Iran’s Revolutionary Guard strikes Bahrain a second time and declares Hormuz closed
stories.dek: Six drones hit a radar at Riffa Air Base before dawn on Sunday; US Central Command says it shot down two, and the carrier Theodore Roosevelt is now the third American flattop in the Gulf.

stories.headline: Washington names Singapore a diversion risk and licences every advanced chip moved here
stories.dek: The 16 November rule covers Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Brazil and Thailand, and says licences will be judged on how well each country enforces its own export controls.

stories.kicker: Technology · Nvidia Reports Without A Chief
stories.headline: Nvidia reports without Jensen Huang as Washington rewrites the chip rules
stories.dek: The results land about twenty past one on Tuesday afternoon in California, with Colette Kress now interim chief executive and guidance set at $108bn, give or take two per cent.

stories.kicker: The Good Life · Studio Underd0g’s First Calendar
stories.headline: Studio Underd0g opens orders today on a £750 Seagull calendar watch
stories.dek: The 04SERIES is the Maidenhead maker’s first automatic: thirty-four new parts, a retrograde date and a moonphase — and a weekend indicator you set by hand.

stories.kicker: Screen & Sound · The November Box Office
stories.headline: Johnny Depp’s Scrooge opens at nineteen million dollars, under Boxoffice Pro’s forecast
stories.dek: Ti West’s Ebenezer took $19m from 3,535 American cinemas over the weekend of 13–15 November, and split its audience from its critics by thirty-six points.

stories.kicker: The Family Desk · Tirzepatide In Adolescents
stories.headline: Tirzepatide cut adolescent body-mass index 18.5 per cent in the SURMOUNT trial
stories.dek: The SURMOUNT-ADOLESCENTS trial, published on 15 November, randomised 160 twelve-to-seventeen-year-olds across 31 centres for 72 weeks; the placebo group gained 0.5 per cent.

stories.kicker: The Macro Desk · A December Hike, Fully Priced
stories.headline: Futures price a 9 December Federal Reserve rise at a hundred per cent
stories.dek: Gold fell to its weakest since October 2025 and Brent dropped 3.67 per cent on a day of open Gulf warfare; only the dollar rose.

stories.headline: England and Wales hold 105,800 kilometres of mortarless stone wall
stories.dek: UNESCO listed the craft in 2018 and extended the entry to thirteen countries in 2024; Britain last surveyed the condition of its walls in 1994.

stories.headline: Reps-in-reserve matches the Borg scale to a third of a repetition
stories.dek: A randomised crossover of 32 lifters, published on 14 November in the Journal of Sports Sciences, puts the gap at 0.03 repetitions on the chest press and 0.16 on the leg extension.

stories.kicker: The Diary · Two Deadlines Before December
stories.headline: ART SG holds Early Bird pricing until 24 November
stories.dek: A Saturday adult pair costs $44 before the Early Bird closes on 24 November and $88 after; the Australian Open’s own early pricing ends at 12.59pm on 30 November, with daily Ground Passes capped for the first time.
